summary: Regression coverage now binds auto-follow and the scoped installation latch: with a persisted rollback_failed installation, follow is asserted to advance to the CI-green repair descendant, after which the real supervisor fixture bootstraps that descendant, keeps the failed candidate barred, accepts the repair, and starts and settles ordinary work. This addresses issue 276 without changing unrelated behavior.

evidence: tests/host/hosted-supervisor-rollback-latch_test.ts:120-145 constructs FollowFake with the persisted rollback_failed record and asserts an advanced decision, the repair launcher SHA, safe dispatch, and one mutation.
tests/host/hosted-supervisor-rollback-latch_test.ts:155-196 prepares the repair bootstrap through the real supervisor fixture, proving the scoped latch allows the descendant install.
tests/host/hosted-supervisor-rollback-latch_test.ts:246-284 asserts the repair is accepted and ordinary work at ROLLBACK_FIX is admitted and settles healthy.
src/host/actions-supervisor-installation.ts:27-37 scopes the latch to the failed candidate, so follow is no longer wedged by controller behavior and the test covers the prior mismatch.
